notes.title: Bad Mineral will be free to play by May 1st
notes.content:
I have confirmed with Steam that Bad Mineral is going free to play after the 30th or April 2024. 
Those who have already bought it will receive an exclusive weapon in the game.

notes.title: Price Change Has Been Delayed
notes.content: I apologize for any inconvenience. I had bad information on the minimum waiting period for changing the price. I will post again when it becomes clear what's happening.

notes.title: Bad Mineral is going Free to Play after the 19th of November!
notes.content: After the recommended one week of forewarning, Bad Mineral will be a game that is free to play.
